content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can set up a professional-looking online store without incurring monthly costs or platform restrictions. This matters because many creators in developing regions face financial barriers that limit their ability to sell products online. By using GitHub Pages, you maintain control over your store and avoid the fees and limitations imposed by conventional platforms. This setup not only empowers creators but also opens new avenues for revenue generation through digital product sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind a GitHub Pages store combines several key components. First, your website is hosted on GitHub, allowing you to create and manage your product listings effortlessly. The backend logic can be implemented using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and delivery. For payment processing, NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring low fees and instant payment confirmation. Together, these elements form a cohesive infrastructure that requires no dependence on traditional payment platforms, giving you full ownership and control of your digital store.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in countries facing payment processing challenges, such as Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products and have been shut out by platforms like PayPal or Gumroad, this solution is tailored for you. It provides an alternative that not only bypasses restrictive payment systems but also enhances your revenue potential by keeping transaction fees low. By choosing this architecture, you position yourself for sustainable income generation in a digital economy.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, empowering creators without costly subscriptions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of a GitHub Pages store comes from its integrated components. GitHub Pages hosts your website, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers manage the backend, ensuring that orders are processed smoothly. Supabase or Google Sheets can be used for order storage, allowing easy tracking of sales and inventory. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation. Together, these elements create a seamless experience for both you and your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your GitHub Pages store, start by creating your GitHub account and setting up a repository for your store. Next, write the HTML/CSS for your product pages, which can be easily managed through GitHub’s interface. Implement backend logic using Google Apps Script for order processing, and configure NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. After setting up product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, test the entire flow to ensure smooth transactions. Finally, launch your store and promote it through social media or other channels.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages to host your store and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms entirely, giving you full control over your sales. By leveraging these tools, you can maintain a professional storefront while keeping fees low and ensuring instant product delivery.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, keeping more money in your pocket.

It includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. Write the HTML/CSS for your product pages within the repository. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency transactions. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant product delivery. Test the complete transaction flow before launching your store. Share your store link through social media to attract potential customers.

You can sell ebooks online by using GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. This setup allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms and retain more revenue.

Utilizing GitHub Pages alongside NOWPayments is an effective way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees. This infrastructure offers low transaction costs and full ownership of your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. With GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can set up a digital store to sell templates and fonts directly to customers, eliminating reliance on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments offers low transaction fees of just 0.5% and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This makes it an ideal choice for creators looking to minimize costs while accepting crypto payments.
Is technical knowledge required to set up a GitHub Pages store?
While some technical knowledge is helpful, many resources can guide you through the process of setting up a GitHub Pages store. Basic understanding of HTML and JavaScript will be beneficial.
